info.long_name: Provisional weekly count of deaths from all causes
info.short_description: Provisional number of deaths from all causes in the week.
info.long_description: Provisional count of deaths from all causes occurring in the MMWR week ending on the given Saturday, by jurisdiction of occurrence. Counts are incomplete for recent weeks because of reporting delays and are revised as death certificates are processed. New York State and New York City are reported separately by NCHS and are summed here into one row for New York. Never suppressed. Weeks for which NCHS has not yet received any death certificates are published as 0 deaths and are set to NA here.
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} deaths from all causes in the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: Weekly all-cause deaths as a percent of expected deaths
info.short_description: Observed weekly all-cause deaths divided by the number expected for that week, times 100.
info.long_description: Percent of expected deaths, as published by NCHS (observed all-cause deaths divided by the expected count for the week, times 100; 100 means as many deaths as expected). For New York, the state and New York City values are recombined through their implied expected counts and rounded to a whole percent. NA for weeks NCHS has not yet reported (published as 0 deaths and 0%).
info.statement: In {location}, deaths in the week ending {time} were {value}% of the expected number.

info.long_name: Provisional weekly count of deaths involving COVID-19
info.short_description: Provisional number of deaths with COVID-19 listed on the death certificate in the week.
info.long_description: Provisional count of deaths involving COVID-19 (ICD-10 U07.1) as an underlying or contributing cause, occurring in the MMWR week ending on the given Saturday. Counts of 1-9 are suppressed by NCHS and imputed as 5 here, with nchs_suppressed_flag_covid = 1. For New York the flag is set if either the state or the New York City part was suppressed (see the flag description). Recent weeks are incomplete and are revised upward.
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} deaths involving COVID-19 in the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: Provisional weekly count of deaths involving pneumonia
info.short_description: Provisional number of deaths with pneumonia listed on the death certificate in the week.
info.long_description: Provisional count of deaths involving pneumonia (ICD-10 J12-J18), with or without COVID-19 or influenza, in the MMWR week ending on the given Saturday. Counts of 1-9 are suppressed by NCHS and imputed as 5 here, with nchs_suppressed_flag_pneumonia = 1. For New York the flag is set if either the state or the New York City part was suppressed (see the flag description).
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} deaths involving pneumonia in the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: Provisional weekly count of deaths involving both pneumonia and COVID-19
info.short_description: Provisional number of deaths with both pneumonia and COVID-19 listed in the week.
info.long_description: Provisional count of deaths involving both pneumonia and COVID-19 in the MMWR week ending on the given Saturday. These deaths are also included in the pneumonia and COVID-19 counts, so the columns must not be added together. Counts of 1-9 are suppressed by NCHS and imputed as 5 here, with nchs_suppressed_flag_pneumonia_covid = 1. For New York the flag is set if either the state or the New York City part was suppressed (see the flag description).
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} deaths involving both pneumonia and COVID-19 in the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: Provisional weekly count of deaths involving influenza
info.short_description: Provisional number of deaths with influenza listed on the death certificate in the week.
info.long_description: Provisional count of deaths involving influenza (ICD-10 J09-J11), with or without pneumonia or COVID-19, in the MMWR week ending on the given Saturday. Counts of 1-9 are suppressed by NCHS and imputed as 5 here, with nchs_suppressed_flag_influenza = 1. For New York the flag is set if either the state or the New York City part was suppressed (see the flag description). In low-activity weeks most states are suppressed, so state totals summed across states are not meaningful in those weeks.
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} deaths involving influenza in the week ending {time}.

info.long_name: Provisional weekly count of deaths involving pneumonia, influenza, or COVID-19 (PIC)
info.short_description: Provisional number of deaths with pneumonia, influenza or COVID-19 listed in the week.
info.long_description: Provisional count of deaths involving pneumonia, influenza, or COVID-19 (any of the three) in the MMWR week ending on the given Saturday, counting each death once. Counts of 1-9 are suppressed by NCHS and imputed as 5 here, with nchs_suppressed_flag_pneumonia_flu_covid = 1. For New York the flag is set if either the state or the New York City part was suppressed (see the flag description).
info.statement: In {location}, there were {value} deaths involving pneumonia, influenza, or COVID-19 in the week ending {time}.

info.short_description: 1 if the COVID-19 deaths count was suppressed by NCHS (1-9 deaths) and imputed as 5, otherwise 0.
info.long_description: NCHS suppresses counts between 1 and 9. Following project convention the suppressed count is replaced by 5 and this flag is set to 1. New York is the sum of the New York State and New York City parts; each suppressed part is imputed as 5 and the flag is 1 if either part was suppressed. Weeks NCHS has not yet reported are NA with the flag 0.

nchs_respiratory_deaths.name: Provisional COVID-19 Death Counts by Week Ending Date and State
nchs_respiratory_deaths.organization: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)
nchs_respiratory_deaths.location: National Vital Statistics System, provisional mortality
nchs_respiratory_deaths.description: Weekly provisional counts of deaths from all causes, COVID-19, pneumonia, influenza, and pneumonia/influenza/COVID-19 combined, by state of occurrence, from death certificates received by NCHS. Covers the United States, the 50 states, the District of Columbia, New York City (summed into New York here, with a suppressed part imputed as 5 and flagged) and Puerto Rico, from the week ending 2020-01-04. Data are provisional: recent weeks are incomplete because of reporting lags and are revised, weeks not yet reported are NA, and counts of 1-9 are suppressed.
nchs_respiratory_deaths.restrictions: Public domain. CDC data is generally not subject to copyright restrictions.
